title: Japanese actress Noa Nakada passed away at 23
text:

 Heidi Hsia Wed, 18 November 2026 at 6:44 am UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. 18 Oct - It was revealed that young Japanese actress Noa Nakada has recently passed away.
 Toho Entertainment announced the news via its official website on 16 November, saying, "We are deeply saddened to inform you of the recent passing of our actress, Noa Nakada."
 The company also revealed that the farewell ceremony and funeral were held in accordance with the family's wishes, with only close relatives in attendance. They also expressed their gratitude to the fans and people in the entertainment industry who supported her during her lifetime.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Born in June 2003 in Ishikawa, Noa was selected as a finalist in the Toho Cinderella pageant and successfully entered the finals. It was through the pageant that she made her acting debut and starred in several TV shows including "The Mocking Lady" and "Ultraman Teo".
 She was 23.
 No further information has been released about the nature of her passing
